messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "HeFH"
set: ["HeFH", "children younger than 8 years of age with HeFH", "HoFH", "children 8 years of age and older with high blood cholesterol due to heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HeFH)", "children younger than 7 years of age with HoFH", "adults with high blood cholesterol due to homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HoFH)", "children 7 years of age and older with high blood cholesterol due to homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HoFH)", "nausea and vomiting associated with HEC", "LDL-C in adults and pediatric patients (10 years and older) with heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HeFH)", "24 mg for HEC", "SIADH", "oral administration recommended for HEC", "Proventil HFA", "blood", "Ventolin HFA", "none"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
